candidates.angle: Kshetra, the body as a field of action
Kshetrajna, the one who knows the field
Krishna names the body as the field

angle_en: Kshetra: the body as a field

en.intro: Krishna begins to answer Arjuna's question with a pair of terms. Listen to how he names the body and the one who knows it.
en.notice: Krishna names the body as the kshetra, the field. The one who knows this field is the kshetrajna, the knower of the field.
en.next: Krishna now identifies Himself as the knower of the field in every body, Arjuna.
en.meaning: The body is called the field, O Arjuna. Those who know it call the knower of the field the field-knower.

hi.intro: कृष्ण अर्जुन के सवाल का जवाब देते हुए दो शब्दों का इस्तेमाल करते हैं। सुनिए, वे शरीर और उसे जानने वाले को कैसे नाम देते हैं।
hi.meaning: श्रीभगवान् कहते हैं, हे कुन्तीपुत्र अर्जुन, यह शरीर क्षेत्र कहलाता है और जो इस क्षेत्र को जानता है, उसे ज्ञानी लोग क्षेत्रज्ञ कहते हैं।
hi.notice: कृष्ण शरीर को क्षेत्र कहते हैं, यानी एक मैदान। जो इस मैदान को जानता है, उसे ज्ञानी लोग क्षेत्रज्ञ कहते हैं।
hi.next: कृष्ण अब स्वयं को हर शरीर के क्षेत्र में जानने वाले के रूप में बताते हैं, अर्जुन।

en.intro: Krishna begins to answer Arjuna's question with a pair of terms. Listen to how he names the body and the one who knows it.
en.body: The body is called the field, O Arjuna. Those who know it call the knower of the field the field-knower. Krishna names the body as the kshetra, the field. The one who knows this field is the kshetrajna, the knower of the field. Krishna now identifies Himself as the knower of the field in every body, Arjuna.
